name: minecraft-first-2027-drop-throwing-disc-offhand-20261115
lines:
يأتي مع أول تحديث في 2027
حسب موجانغ (Mojang)

سيحمل لاعبو نسخة Bedrock
أي غرض بأي يد

لم تحدد موجانغ بعد
موعد صدور التحديث
credits: المصدر: موجانغ (Mojang) ولقطات من عرض دعائي سابق
headline:
قرص رمي يعود إليك
في Minecraft
label: رسمي
bed_reason: The news has no video or sound of its own (Mojang's one full-size image on X and four 1280x720 stills on minecraft.net); the moving picture is stand-in footage from the Minecraft Nintendo Switch 2 launch trailer (IGN 2560 copy), whose own sound is that release's launch music and, from about 55 s, Super Mario sound effects that belong to another release; the Ice Caves trailer (IGN 1080p, 2.5 Mbps, a 7.5-minute showcase with narration) was opened and not used. So our bed plays under the stills, card and stand-in shots.

tried: minecraft.net article: four 1280x720 stills (also as the DAM original rendition), no video; Tile names only, no larger renditions (1920x1080 and Header variants 404)
@Minecraft X post 2121724898582388832: one 2578x2578 image (used, cropped clear of the sword), no video

Minecraft's TwitchCon showing: the stream VOD is on Twitch and YouTube (not fetched: no account-free official download route; YouTube needs a sign-in, 28 Sep rule); no clip of the disc posted as video on X

IGN Minecraft videos: no drop or TwitchCon video; The Ice Caves trailer (Sep 2026, 1080p 2.5 Mbps, long narrated showcase) opened, not used; Wilderness Bound launch trailer (Sep 2026) listed; Nintendo Switch 2 launch trailer (Oct 2026, 2560x1440) used as credited stand-in
Mojang press kit / minecraft.net media: no press kit for this drop found on minecraft.net; store pages carry no drop video
Dexerto, Denfaminicogamer: the X image only
Recording the source page as video: not used (static text and the same 720p stills)

spoken: قرص رمي يعود إليك في Minecraft، يأتي مع أول تحديث في 2027 حسب موجانغ (Mojang)، ويُصنع القرص من خمس خامات. وسيحمل لاعبو نسخة Bedrock أي غرض بأي يد، كما في نسخة Java منذ 2016. ولم تحدد موجانغ بعد موعد صدور التحديث.

angle.hook: a weapon that comes back to you: Minecraft's first 2027 drop adds a returning throwing disc
angle.why_now: Mojang revealed it on its TwitchCon stream and on minecraft.net on 14 Nov 2026 (X post 22:00Z)
angle.what_it_means_here: Bedrock players (consoles, phones, Windows) get the off-hand Java has had since 2016; no date yet
angle.payoff: both features arrive with the first drop of 2027, date not announced

decision_log.shot: @Minecraft X image 2578x2578: the player holding the diamond throwing disc at sunset, window x 1015 to 2465 of the source (the sword and its hand at x 880 to 990 left out; a zombie stands far right on the dirt ledge, not attacking)
decision_log.alternatives: minecraft.net disc01 (720p, 2.67x: rejected); disc02 (mobs knocked down: rejected)

decision_log.shot: stand-in: Switch 2 launch trailer 12.2 s, Steve by a tree with flowers and a pig
our fact card (5 خامات, the five named) over the same trailer at 44 s (jungle sunset), dimmed

decision_log.beat: 3 Bedrock: any item in either hand
decision_log.shot: stand-in: trailer 35 s, first-person farming with an item in hand
stand-in: trailer 27 s, Steve among his animals at a village farm
stand-in: trailer 46 s, desert village at sunset (a picture, not a card, for the last two seconds)

reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: 'spoken' written first; lines are that paragraph in order; Mojang and the disc named before any pronoun; no line opens on و
